title: Multiplayer
description: Online server client (Multiplayer > Connect to Server: sign-in, server ban list, duel tracking) and the online duel system logging.

settings.title: Server url
settings.help: Base URL of the multiplayer server (YgoMp, e.g. http://localhost:5080). Multiplayer > Connect to Server signs in here. Empty = offline: the duel recorder (Duels.log) and logging still work.

settings.title: Claim code
settings.help: Sign in with a code the server's host minted (YgoMp.SelfHost mint) instead of Steam: for Epic/GOG copies. Empty = Steam.

settings.title: Display name
settings.help: The name a claim code's account gets the first time it signs in.
